recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆巨核細胞，細胞體積偏小，核為單一、圓形、不分葉且位置偏心，周圍有淡紫色顆粒狀細胞質（顯示已成熟產生血小板顆粒）；這種單核圓形巨核細胞是 del(5q) 骨髓分化不良症候群的典型表現。
features: Megakaryocyte smaller than typical mature forms
Single round, non-lobated, eccentric nucleus with coarse granular chromatin
Moderate to abundant pale lilac granular cytoplasm indicating cytoplasmic maturation
Nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony (mature cytoplasm with non-lobated nucleus)
Background with red cells, small lymphoid-appearing cells, and a neutrophil; poor image resolution
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a megakaryocyte with a single round, non-lobated, eccentrically placed nucleus and moderately abundant pale granular cytoplasm. The cell is smaller than a normal mature megakaryocyte, and the granular cytoplasm contrasts with the lack of nuclear lobation. Image resolution is limited. Findings are consistent with a mononuclear (hypolobated) dysplastic megakaryocyte, characteristic of myelodysplastic neoplasm with isolated del(5q).

ddx.vs: Immature megakaryocytes have deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm with blebs, whereas this cell has mature granular cytoplasm despite a round nucleus.
Micromegakaryocytes are near lymphocyte size with scant cytoplasm, while 5q- megakaryocytes are medium-sized with more abundant cytoplasm.
Osteoblasts have a paranuclear hof away from nucleus and occur in clusters, and plasma cells have basophilic cytoplasm, neither with fine platelet-type granules.
